meta.name: axolotl
meta.description: Expert guidance for fine-tuning LLMs with Axolotl - YAML configs, 100+ models, LoRA/QLoRA, DPO/KTO/ORPO/GRPO, multimodal support

copy.tagline: 用 Axolotl 微调大语言模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用 Axolotl 微调 LLM 并配置 LoRA/QLoRA。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to fine-tune LLMs using Axolotl with LoRA/QLoRA.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能指导你使用 Axolotl 微调大语言模型，包括编写 YAML 配置、选择 LoRA/QLoRA 等方法、处理数据集、调试代码，并支持多模态模型。
howto.when: 当你询问关于 Axolotl 的功能、API、实现或调试，或学习其最佳实践时触发。

say.text: 如何在 Axolotl 中启用模型压缩保存？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you in fine-tuning large language models with Axolotl, including writing YAML configs, choosing methods like LoRA/QLoRA, handling datasets, debugging code, and supporting multimodal models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about Axolotl features, APIs, implementation, debugging, or learning best practices.

say_en.text: Help me write an Axolotl YAML config for fine-tuning Llama 3 with LoRA.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a corresponding YAML config example.

say_en.text: Explain the context_parallel_size parameter in Axolotl.
say_en.note: Claude will explain the parameter and its effect on batch processing.

say_en.text: How to enable compressed model saving in Axolotl?
say_en.note: Claude will describe the save_compressed config and its benefits.
